name: Sona Machinery Ltd.
summary: Sona Machinery Ltd. is an Indian original equipment manufacturer and supplier specializing in agro-processing machinery. The company primarily operates within the agro-processing and grain milling industries, providing solutions for processing various grains such as rice, pulses, wheat, sesame, millet, corn, barley, gram, lentils, and seeds. Its main offerings include complete turnkey rice mill setups with capacities ranging from 3 to 10 tons per hour, and grain milling machines for grain-based ethanol distilleries. The product portfolio encompasses a variety of equipment for cleaning, processing, polishing, and packaging, such as rotary drum cleaners, pre-cleaners, fine cleaners, Vibro screen cleaners, stone separators, paddy huskers, rice whiteners, silky polishers, color sorters, graders, and material handling systems. Sona Machinery also provides customized engineered solutions, full project installation and commissioning, and after-sales support including preventive maintenance, training, and spare parts. The company serves a diverse client base including large enterprises, government public sector undertakings, and individual farmers across India and in global markets, with a notable presence and office in African countries like Kenya, Nigeria, and Chad, and neighboring countries like Nepal and Sri Lanka.
